_comment: How research subsystems are presented: a few groups per system, and physical corners where it matters. 'groups' map research subsystems wholesale; 'corners' splits parts in the listed subsystems by where they sit on the car (FL/FR/RL/RR), with centre pieces going to 'centerFront' / 'centerRear' (or 'center'). Parts with no 3D model in a corner subsystem go to 'noModel'.

groups.name: Body Shell & Structure
groups.desc: The bare unibody: rails, strut towers, floor, pillars, rockers and trunk floor.

groups.name: Welds, Gussets & Braces
groups.desc: Stitch welding, gussets, backing plates and strut-tower braces that stiffen the shell.

groups.name: Tunnel & Mounting Points
groups.desc: Transmission tunnel, driveshaft loop, jack/tow points, rivnuts and weld-on tabs.

groups.name: Strip, Seal & Paint
groups.desc: Prep work on the bare shell: deadener removal, seam sealer, primer and coatings.

groups.name: Roll Cage
groups.desc: Every cage bar, mounting plate, gusset and pad.

groups.name: Seat, Belts & Net
groups.desc: Race seat and mounts, 6-point harness, head restraint and window net.

groups.name: Fire System & Kill Switches
groups.desc: Plumbed fire suppression, handheld extinguisher and kill-switch pulls.

groups.name: Firewalls & Tow Points
groups.desc: Bulkheads sealing the cockpit from fuel and engine, and tow straps.

groups.name: Front Left
groups.desc: Everything suspension at the front left corner: strut, spring, top mount, knuckle, lower links, end link, bump stop.

groups.name: Front Right
groups.desc: Everything suspension at the front right corner.

groups.name: Front Subframe & Sway Bar
groups.desc: Front cradle, its mounts and braces, and the front sway bar between the corners.

groups.name: Rear Left
groups.desc: Everything suspension at the rear left corner: five links, knuckle, shock, spring, end link.

groups.name: Rear Right
groups.desc: Everything suspension at the rear right corner.

groups.name: Rear Subframe & Sway Bar
groups.desc: Rear cradle, its bushings and braces, and the rear sway bar.

groups.name: Alignment & Setup
groups.desc: Alignment, ride height, corner weights and final torque at ride height.

groups.name: Front Left
groups.desc: Inner and outer tie rod and bump-steer parts on the left.

groups.name: Front Right
groups.desc: Inner and outer tie rod and bump-steer parts on the right.

groups.name: Steering Rack
groups.desc: Electric power steering rack, motor and mounts on the front subframe.

groups.name: Steering Wheel & Column
groups.desc: Race wheel, quick release, column and intermediate shafts down to the rack.

groups.name: Front Left
groups.desc: Front left caliper, rotor, pads, flex hose, duct and wheel-speed sensor.

groups.name: Front Right
groups.desc: Front right caliper, rotor, pads, flex hose, duct and wheel-speed sensor.

groups.name: Rear Left
groups.desc: Rear left caliper, rotor, pads, flex hose, park-brake parts and sensor.

groups.name: Rear Right
groups.desc: Rear right caliper, rotor, pads, flex hose, park-brake parts and sensor.

groups.name: Pedal Box & Master Cylinders
groups.desc: Pedals, balance bar, master cylinders, reservoirs and booster.

groups.name: ABS, Hard Lines & Park Brake
groups.desc: ABS unit, hard lines running the length of the car, and the park-brake controls.

groups.name: Fluid, Bleeding & Bedding
groups.desc: Brake fluid spec, bleed order and pad bedding procedure.

groups.name: Front Left
groups.desc: Hub and bearing, studs and lug nuts, wheel, tyre and TPMS at the front left.

groups.name: Front Right
groups.desc: Front right hub, studs, wheel and tyre.

groups.name: Rear Left
groups.desc: Rear left hub, axle nut, studs, wheel and tyre.

groups.name: Rear Right
groups.desc: Rear right hub, axle nut, studs, wheel and tyre.

groups.name: Wheel Supplies & TPMS
groups.desc: Parts and supplies shared by all four wheels.

groups.name: Block & Bottom End
groups.desc: Block, crank, rods, pistons, bearings, oil pan and the crank flange.

groups.name: Heads, Cam & Valvetrain

groups.name: Supercharger & Intake
groups.desc: LT4 supercharger, intercooler bricks, lid, throttle body (or NA intake).

groups.name: Fuel Injection & Ignition
groups.desc: Direct-injection pump, rails, injectors, coils and plugs.

groups.name: Front Cover & Belt Drive
groups.desc: Front cover, balancer, water pump, belts, tensioner and pulleys.

groups.name: Engine Mounts & Sensors

groups.name: Oil System

groups.name: Exhaust

groups.name: Driveshaft

groups.name: Rear Differential

groups.name: Battery, Power & Grounds

groups.name: Engine Electronics

groups.desc: Dash display, keypad, switches, radio, camera and transponder.

groups.name: Wiring Harness

groups.name: Lighting
groups.desc: Headlights, brake lights, rain light and markers.

groups.name: Dash, Panels & Mirrors

groups.name: Splitter & Canards
groups.desc: Front splitter, air dam, support rods, skid blocks and canards.

groups.name: Ducts & Vents
